purpose: The declared sinks for DPK-SAST-582 and DPK-SAST-583 must both be reported from one fixture.

groundTruth.rationale: The fixture lines contain the exact constructs the rules declare: DPK-SAST-582 -> readOnlyRootFilesystem: false; DPK-SAST-583 -> verbs: ["*".

The final line is a safe counterpart: any detection on it is an unexpected line and fails the case.
